summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.total: sums the tenant's approved entries (refunds included) and rounds the result to 2 decimal places with MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero (RQ-FXL-0003, DF-FXL-0007). RQ-FXL-0103 (banker's rounding) is superseded and was not followed.

criteria.test: total rounds a positive half-cent midpoint away from zero
total rounds a negative half-cent midpoint away from zero

criteria.criterion: Unapproved entries and other tenants' entries do not count
criteria.test: total ignores unapproved entries and other tenants

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.approve using FxIdentity.Identity.isActive and hasRole. Checks run in the RQ-FXL-0004 order (active session, Approver role, entry found in the session's tenant, then the RQ-FXL-0104 high-value rule, self-approval, already-approved). On success the entry gets Approved=true and ApprovedBy=Some UserId, and nothing else changes. fx-identity was not modified.

criteria.criterion: A session idle for exactly 15 minutes can approve
criteria.test: approve accepts a session idle for exactly 15 minutes

criteria.criterion: A session idle for 15 minutes 1 second gets SessionExpired
criteria.test: approve rejects a session idle for 15 minutes and 1 second

criteria.criterion: An Admin without Approver gets NotAuthorized
criteria.test: approve rejects an Admin without Approver

criteria.criterion: An entry of another tenant is reported as NotFound, never NotAuthorized
criteria.test: approve reports an entry of another tenant as NotFound

criteria.criterion: Approving an already approved entry gives AlreadyApproved
criteria.test: approve rejects an entry that is already approved

criteria.criterion: On success the entry gets Approved = true and ApprovedBy = Some session.UserId, with nothing else changed
criteria.test: approve sets Approved and ApprovedBy on success

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0104: approving an entry of 10,000.01 with Approver but without Admin gets NotAuthorized
criteria.test: high-value approval of 10000.01 needs Admin as well as Approver

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0104: an entry of exactly 10,000 needs only Approver
criteria.test: approval of exactly 10000 needs only Approver

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0104: a session holding both Approver and Admin can approve an entry of 10,000.01
criteria.test: high-value approval succeeds for a session with Approver and Admin

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.view: returns SessionExpired when the session is not active (FxIdentity.Identity.isActive), otherwise the entries whose TenantId equals the session's tenant, in original order, for every role including Admin (RQ-FXL-0006, DF-FXL-0005). DF-FXL-0002 (admin cross-tenant view) is superseded and was not followed. Note: fx-ledger/README.md still says administrators can view all tenants; that line is stale and was left unchanged.

criteria.criterion: An Admin of t1 sees only t1 entries
criteria.test: view returns only the session tenant's entries for an Admin
view of an expired session gets SessionExpired

summary: Not implemented. RQ-FXL-0008 is still proposed and depends on DF-FXL-0009, which is a draft with no rates source chosen and no rates available to the ledger. The rounding rule and rate date are unspecified, and RQ-FXL-0008 has no acceptance criteria, so there is nothing testable to implement. FxLedger.Ledger.convertCurrency still raises 'not implemented'. Unblock by accepting DF-FXL-0009 and specifying rounding, rate date and acceptance criteria in RQ-FXL-0008.

criteria.criterion: Amounts convert between ISO 4217 currencies using the rates source chosen in DF-FXL-0009
Rounding and rate date are specified (currently unspecified in RQ-FXL-0008)
